subject: SiriusX throughput degradation & timeouts — interim fixes and next steps
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@starlite.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Nov 2028 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: SiriusX failing for production svc - 5xx / streaming timeouts

Hi Stephanie —

Heads up: starting ~08:45 PST we started seeing a spike of 5xx and streaming timeouts from Redwood when hitting model 'SiriusX' v2.0. The errors are primarily 504 gateway timeouts for streaming requests; about 6% of our calls fail and a subset see 500s. This is impacting our chat features for logged-in users.

We've attached a few request ids and a short sample log. Can you confirm whether this is an infra or model regression? Our engineering team is standing by and can take local mitigations on our side if helpful.

Sample request ids: req_ab12, req_ab13, req_ab37
Attachments: siriusx-error-sample.log

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Head of Integrations, Starlite AI
ops@starlite.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@starlite.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Nov 2028 08:58:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SiriusX failing for production svc - 5xx / streaming timeouts

Hi Lina — thanks for the heads up and the sample traces. I’m investigating now and have looped in our on-call SRE and the model team. Initial notes:

- We are seeing an elevated 5xx rate for SiriusX v2 across a subset of capacity pools in us-west-2.
- Streaming disconnects correlate with bursts of long-tail generation latencies for requests >800 tokens.

Immediate steps we’re taking (interim):
1) Route affected tenants to SiriusX-small (compatibility-tested smaller variant) to restore availability — doing a staged roll starting 09:05 PST.
2) Increase autoscale headroom on the affected pools.
3) Throttle long-running generation by default at 90s for the next 2 hours to reduce tail latency.

I’ll update you at 09:20 PST with the first metrics after the traffic shift. We take this seriously and will run a more thorough postmortem.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you posted.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: SiriusX failing for production svc - urgent triage (routing/fallback in progress)

Forwarding customer report — we have routing to SiriusX-small in progress (staged). Early reduction in 5xx observed but still investigating root cause. Details:

Observed behavior:
- Spike in token generation latency for sequences >800 tokens starting ~08:42 PST concentrated in pool gw-usw2-a and gw-usw2-b.
- Queue depth on two inference nodes increased causing connection timeouts and 504s at the gateway.
- No immediate OOMs in logs; memory pressure appears normal.

Hypothesis so far:
- A kernel path used for attention tiling under certain sequence-length distributions shows degradation under concurrent long sequences (SiriusX v2 specific). Model team to validate kernel heuristics.

Action items assigned:
- @karthik_iyer: capture perf profile for a representative trace and verify kernel selection logic (ETA 45m).
- @ben_carter: continue staged routing to SiriusX-small and monitor tail latency; ensure canary is healthy (ETA 15m).
- @marissa_cole: prepare customer-facing status note and coordinate with Lina.

Attachments: siriusx-error-sample.log, siriusx-metrics-20281119.csv

Please update this thread with findings and let me know if you need expanded capacity.

Hi Lina — quick update from our side:

- We completed stage 1 of the routing shift at 09:05 PST. Affected traffic for your account was sent to SiriusX-small.
- Observed 5xx rate drop: from ~6% to ~0.8% within the first 10 minutes. Streaming disconnects largely resolved.
- We’ve left the 90s generation throttle in place to keep tail latency bounded while we finish root cause.

Next:
- We’d like to run a controlled 20% traffic test to SiriusX v2 at 11:00 PST once we have the full perf profile. This will let us validate fixes without a full roll. Are you okay with a short test window at that time?

Attachments: siriusx-fallback-rollout-notes.pdf

Thanks for your patience,
Marissa Cole

Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Post-incident summary: SiriusX elevated 5xx/timeouts — root cause & next steps

Hi Lina / Starlite team —

Summary of what happened (11/19):
- Between 08:42–09:30 PST we observed an increase in 5xx (504/500) and streaming disconnects for SiriusX v2, concentrated in two inference capacity pools (gw-usw2-a/b).
- Immediate mitigation: staged routing to SiriusX-small and a temporary 90s generation timeout reduced customer-visible failures from ~6% to <1%.

Root cause (high level):
- A kernel selection heuristic in our inference runtime incorrectly selected an attention tiling path for certain long-sequence workloads on SiriusX v2. Under concurrent long-sequence load the chosen path exhibited severe tail latency. This is a model-variant specific interaction with our GPU kernel selector.

Actions completed:
- Hotfix: Adjusted kernel selection heuristics to prefer the stable execution path for sequences >512 tokens (deployed 11/20).
- Capacity: Increased headroom in affected pools and added an automatic fallback to SiriusX-small for high tail-latency signals.
- Monitoring: New alert rule to surface sequence-length correlated tail latency across model variants.

Pending items / timeline:
- SRE/ModelOps to conduct a controlled verification run for the kernel heuristic across all regions (JIRA SRE-7894, ETA complete 11/26).
- Postmortem doc with perf profiles and reproducer attached to our drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-siriusx-postmortem

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. If you’d like a short call to walk through the technical details and mitigations, we’re happy to schedule one.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
